statement: You are given a doubly linked list whose values, listed head to tail in values, are sorted in non-decreasing order. Each node has a next pointer and a prev pointer.

Remove nodes so that each value appears only once. Since the list is sorted, equal values sit next to each other: keep the first node of each run and unlink the rest, repairing the links in both directions.
Return the resulting list, read from its head.

examples.explanation: One extra 1 and one extra 3 are unlinked, so two nodes are removed.
Two extra 2s and one extra 5 are removed, leaving one node of each value.
